We decided to try this place because of its pretty unique concept. There’s a laundry shop on one side and a coffee shop beside it. There was a power outage in our neighborhood, so my partner continued working here for a while. The staff were very attentive and nice. The only small downside was that since the place is quite small, you can really hear them talking loudly sometimes hahaha. The air conditioning was okay, just enough that you won’t sweat, but it wasn’t cold. As for the food and drinks, they were honestly just okay for us. Also, there were some work-related websites that my partner couldn’t access while using their internet, though we’re not really sure why. Overall, it’s still a decent place if you just want somewhere nearby to chill or work.
